title: try out my new destruction sandbox on tavamadethis.com
author: Spirited_Carpet5109
selftext: pretty fun lil game, i like to play as rick and morty. The 3 maps have a ton of small details and easter eggs so check em out. Works on desktop and mobile phone. [tavamadethis.com](http://tavamadethis.com)

comments.author: ross2000
comments.body: My son is gonna love this. Thanks for sharing.

comments.author: Scrample2121
comments.body: Played for 20 mins, fun! Need to make the gangs fight each other and maybe a way to introduce zombies that spread and cops can shoot.

replies.author: Spirited_Carpet5109
replies.body: thanks so much 🙏 Yes zombies are a great idea for fun add on!
